stemMd: In a large randomly mating population at Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium, 9% of individuals show a fully penetrant autosomal recessive trait. What fraction are heterozygous at that locus?
explanationMd: The recessive phenotype frequency is q squared = 0.09, so q = 0.3 and p = 0.7. Heterozygotes occur at 2pq = 2 times 0.7 times 0.3 = 0.42. The equilibrium assumption is essential to this inference.

distractorRationale.d: This is the dominant homozygote frequency.
distractorRationale.e: This is the total unaffected frequency.
distractorRationale.b: This is the recessive allele frequency.
distractorRationale.a: This is the recessive homozygote frequency.
